title: Fixing a machine’s choice bit
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $b,b'\in\{0,1\}$, and let $x$ be a finite Boolean input. For every configuration $C$ of the machine obtained from $N$ by fixing its choice bit to $b$, the step of that fixed machine using $b'$ agrees with the step of $N$ using $b$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Bool
Configuration of the machine with choice bit fixed to $b$
